name: Docket
summary: A focused web product that brings AI-assisted case preparation into a workflow designed for U.S. immigration attorneys.
clientProblem: Immigration case preparation involves gathering and working through substantial case information. Docket needed a focused product experience that presented its purpose clearly and gave attorneys a structured place to work through case preparation.
xplRole: XPL provided product engineering for Docket's web experience, translating the product direction into the marketing, partnership, and case-workspace interfaces represented in the approved project material.
deliverables: A public-facing marketing experience explaining Docket's purpose
A partnership experience for firms and collaborators
A case-preparation workspace for the product's core workflow
Connected web application interfaces built around the approved product direction
approach: Clarified the product around a specific professional workflow instead of presenting AI as a general-purpose feature.
Separated public product communication, partnership information, and authenticated case work into distinct interfaces.
Implemented the experience with Next.js and tRPC, with Perplexity supporting the product's AI-assisted workflow.
Kept the interface focused on usable case preparation rather than exposing underlying technical complexity to the user.

Implemented interfaces for the product's escrow-backed workflow across its recorded blockchain and application stack.
